title: Feit-Thompson odd order theorem
statement: Every finite group of odd order is solvable.
how_it_was_proved: Feit and Thompson (1963); checked in Coq with the Mathematical Components library by Gonthier and coauthors (2012).

sources.cite: G. Gonthier et al., A machine-checked proof of the odd order theorem, ITP 2013, LNCS 7998, 163-179
